topics.title: First setup
topics.summary: Use a compatible toolchain and your own signing setup. Check phone behavior and expiry separately.

steps.instruction: Use full compatible Xcode and an installed iOS runtime. Review your own account, trust, signing and device prompts personally; do not repeat working setup without a reason.
steps.success: The intended sample app opens; its actual signing expiry is checked separately.

steps.instruction: Test songs, loops, speed/pitch, reverb, locked playback and an interruption with a small sample.
steps.success: Results identify the tested build and device without claiming exhaustive reliability.

steps.instruction: If choosing SideStore, follow its current official Stable guide and personally handle credentials, verification codes, trust, pairing, VPN and certificate decisions.
steps.success: Manual refresh of both apps succeeds before any automation is relied on.

topics.title: Import and listen offline
topics.summary: Start with a small .stillroomlibrary export. The phone keeps managed local copies.

steps.instruction: Keep the Mac export, transfer a copy through an available Files, iCloud Drive, AirDrop or Finder route, and download cloud-only files before import.
steps.success: The complete file is available on the phone.

steps.instruction: Choose Import library, review the preview and notices, then Import into offline library. Keep the original export.
steps.success: The sample songs and ordered playlist appear without overwriting conflicts.

steps.instruction: Test airplane-mode playback and relaunch, saved loops, the chosen transfer route and a sample backup restore.
steps.success: The samples work without the Mac or network, and the external backup restores in a disposable empty library.

topics.title: Speed, pitch and reverb
topics.summary: Expand the speed readout to adjust it; added reverb is in Advanced options.

steps.instruction: Move the speed slider between 0.5× and 2×. It gently snaps near familiar speeds without preventing other values.
steps.success: The current speed is shown and the musical loop boundaries remain the same.

steps.instruction: Pitch follows speed starts on. Turn it off to change timing while retaining the original pitch.
steps.success: Both modes sound as expected on the real phone.

steps.instruction: Compare reverb at zero, a small amount and maximum on a song and a loop.
steps.success: Zero is dry; changes do not cause clicks, sudden volume jumps or broken playback.

topics.title: Refresh both apps
topics.summary: SideStore requires separate setup and validation. Refreshing renews signing permission; it does not back up music.

steps.instruction: First verify the selected signing route and actual expiry. If using SideStore after setup, use Wi-Fi and LocalDevVPN as its current guide requires, then open My Apps.
steps.success: SideStore can perform a manual refresh; no expiry date is guessed.

steps.instruction: Refresh SideStore itself and Pocket Stillroom. Stop for unexpected account or certificate prompts.
steps.success: Both actual expiry indicators move forward and both apps reopen.

steps.instruction: Treat a Shortcuts automation as an experiment until the actual phone and app version pass repeated tests. Keep manual refresh available.
steps.success: Expiry dates confirm success, rather than a shortcut notification alone.

topics.title: Back up and recover
topics.summary: Save an external backup. If the app cannot open its library, recovery creates a separate validated copy.

steps.instruction: Use Prepare backup, then Share backup. Save outside the app’s own folder and keep a Mac copy. During preparation, Cancel operation stops the work; keep the last independent backup.
steps.success: A completed external sample restores with matching songs, playlist order and loops; cancelled output is not treated as a backup.

steps.instruction: If the app opens but its library cannot open, choose Choose backup, Review backup, then Restore into a new library. It retains the original and failed copies, so allow additional space.
steps.success: Only a separately validated copy becomes the selected library. Ordinary healthy-library import instead merges compatible IDs and refuses conflicts.

steps.instruction: If an app expires, do not delete it first. Check which apps still open and follow the current signing-tool recovery guide.
steps.success: Both apps open again without assuming reinstall preserved data.

steps.instruction: Personally handle renewed pairing, sign-in, trust or security approval. Keep the intended app identity for ordinary updates.
steps.success: The restored or updated library passes the same sample checks.

topics.title: I'm stuck
topics.summary: Start with what you can see: app will not open, refresh failed, file unavailable, import rejected or audio problem.

steps.instruction: Keep existing music and exports. Note the exact visible message and the step that failed.
steps.success: The problem can be described without exposing account or signing secrets.

steps.instruction: For refresh issues, compare manual refresh with the shortcut. For audio, note the sample, rate, pitch mode, loop times and output device.
steps.success: A small reproducible case is available.

steps.instruction: Use the external troubleshooting guide if the app cannot open. Do not change security settings or delete data blindly.
steps.success: The next action has a clear purpose and recovery path.
